description: Premier League football analytics: transfer values, match predictions, player scouting.

features.name: supabase_schema
features.title: Supabase database schema with RLS
features.description: Six tables (players, player_stats, transfer_values, matches, match_predictions, player_clusters) with row-level security allowing public read-only access.
acceptance: All 6 tables exist with correct columns and types
RLS enabled on every table with SELECT policy for anon role
No INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE permissions for anon role

features.name: kaggle_ingestion
features.title: Kaggle player stats ingestion pipeline
features.description: Downloads the davidcariboo/player-scores Kaggle dataset, filters Premier League rows, maps positions/ages, and upserts into players and player_stats tables.
acceptance: Filters appearances to PL competition (GB1) only
Derives season labels (e.g. 2024-2025) from match dates
Reuses existing players by name (no duplicates)
Batch upserts are idempotent and safe to re-run

features.name: transfermarkt_ingestion
features.title: Transfermarkt market value ingestion
features.description: Fetches Transfermarkt player valuations from an R2-hosted snapshot and upserts real_value_eur into transfer_values, matching players by name.
acceptance: Matches players to transfer_values by name (not FK id)
No duplicate players created on re-run

features.name: football_data_ingestion
features.title: football-data.org match ingestion
features.description: Fetches Premier League historical and scheduled fixtures from the football-data.org API into the matches table.
acceptance: Fetches historical results and scheduled fixtures
Handles API errors gracefully (rate limits, 403 on old seasons)

features.name: transfer_value_features
features.title: Transfer value feature engineering
features.description: Builds an 8-column feature set (minutes, goals/90, assists/90, age, position one-hots) from a left join of transfer_values, players, and player_stats.
acceptance: Feature columns: minutes_played, goals_per90, assists_per90, age_at_season, pos_DF, pos_FW, pos_GK, pos_MF
Left join from transfer_values keeps all labeled players (265 training rows)

features.name: transfer_value_model
features.title: Transfer value prediction model (RandomForest)
features.description: Trains a RandomForestRegressor on labeled transfer values, saves a dated .joblib artifact, and predicts market values for all qualified players.
acceptance: Predictions vary across players (not a constant value)

features.name: transfer_value_upsert
features.title: Transfer value prediction upsert to DB
features.description: Loads the latest trained model, predicts for all players with >=270 minutes, computes value_gap_pct vs real value, and batch-upserts into transfer_values.
acceptance: Only players with >=270 minutes_played get predictions
value_gap_pct = (predicted - real) / real * 100 for labeled players
Batch upsert (BATCH=200) — no per-row API calls

features.name: transfer_pipeline_orchestrator
features.title: Transfer value pipeline orchestrator
features.description: run_pipeline.py chains train() then predict_and_upsert() as the single entry point for the monthly CI workflow.
acceptance: No duplicated logic between run_pipeline and train/predict modules
Works with PYTHONPATH set to project root

features.name: scouting_features
features.title: Scouting feature engineering
features.description: Builds a 2-column feature set (goals_per90, assists_per90) per position group with a 270-minute minimum filter.

features.name: scouting_clustering
features.title: Scouting KMeans clustering model
features.description: Trains separate KMeans models per position group on the 2D scaled features and saves scaler + cluster artifacts.
acceptance: One KMeans model per position group (GK, DF, MF, FW)
Scaler + model saved as .joblib with date stamp
Cluster assignments generated for all qualified players

features.name: scouting_vector_upsert
features.title: Scouting cluster + vector upsert
features.description: Assigns cluster labels and writes 2D feature vectors (vector(2)) into player_clusters with batched upserts.

features.name: similar_players_rpc
features.title: Similar players pgvector RPC
features.description: Postgres function that returns the top-N most similar players by L2 distance on feature_vector, filtered by position group.
acceptance: RPC signature: similar_players(query_vector vector(2), pos_group text, exclude_id uuid, match_count int)
Returns players ordered by L2 distance
Excludes the query player from results
Works from frontend via anon key

features.name: match_outcome_features
features.title: Match outcome feature engineering
features.description: Builds form-based features (last 5 results) and ELO ratings for match outcome prediction.
acceptance: Form computed from last 5 match results per team

features.name: match_outcome_model
features.title: Match outcome prediction model (XGBoost)
features.description: Trains an XGBClassifier on historical PL results to predict win/draw/loss probabilities for upcoming fixtures.

features.name: transfer_value_page
features.title: Transfer Value module page (/transfers)
features.description: Server-rendered page with player search, detailed stats table, predicted vs real value comparison, and over/undervalued gap indicator.
acceptance: Stats table: minutes, goals, assists, per-90 rates, age, position
Predicted value vs real value displayed with EUR formatting

features.name: matches_page
features.title: Match Predictions module page (/matches)
features.description: Server-rendered page listing upcoming and historical PL fixtures with win/draw/loss probability bars and recent form badges.
acceptance: Form badges for both teams (last 5 results)

features.name: scouting_page
features.title: Scouting module page (/scouting)
features.description: Server-rendered page with player search that shows top-10 similar players via pgvector RPC, with radar chart and similarity scores.
acceptance: Calls similar_players RPC and renders top-10 results

features.name: shared_search_component
features.title: Shared PlayerSearchBox component
features.description: Single debounced search component reused across transfers and scouting pages with dropdown results and name deduplication.
acceptance: Dropdown with player names and positions
Used by both /transfers and /scouting (no duplicate implementations)

features.name: landing_page
features.title: Landing page with module cards
features.description: Home page with three gradient cards linking to Transfers, Matches, and Scouting modules.

features.name: ui_redesign
features.title: Modern UI redesign (slate palette)

acceptance: Glass header with backdrop-blur and gradient brand text
Slate palette replaces gray (text-slate-500 minimum for labels)
Geist font loaded (not overridden to Arial)
Loading/error/404 pages in Spanish with consistent styling
npm run build passes with no errors

features.name: player_deduplication
features.title: Player deduplication migration
features.description: One-time SQL migration that merges duplicate players by name, migrates foreign keys, and prevents future duplicates.
acceptance: Players reduced from 4,725 to 3,365 (0 duplicate names)
FKs in player_stats, player_clusters, transfer_values migrated to surviving rows

features.name: ci_transfer_pipeline
features.title: Monthly transfer value CI pipeline
features.description: GitHub Actions workflow that runs Kaggle ingestion, Transfermarkt ingestion, transfer model train+predict, and scouting train+predict on the 1st of each month.
acceptance: Steps: Kaggle ingest → Transfermarkt ingest → transfer train+predict → scouting train+predict
Uses SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY, KAGGLE_USERNAME, KAGGLE_KEY secrets
PYTHONPATH set for src module resolution

features.name: ci_match_pipeline
features.title: Weekly match prediction CI pipeline
features.description: GitHub Actions workflow that runs football-data.org ingestion and match model train+predict every Monday.
acceptance: Steps: match ingest → match train → match predict
PYTHONPATH set for src module resolution

features.name: readme_documentation

Environment variables table (names only, no values)

Frontend radar chart renders new features
